$comment: One view folder = one lazy bundle (dist/views/live.js): the live cards of docs/peps/0012-live-data.md. uPlot draws the plot (decided 2026-10-27: the live time series only; every other chart stays Vega-Lite). A page that shows only live plots never loads Vega.

views.name: Live plot
views.summary: Dense signals over time, Foxglove's Plot panel and PlotJuggler's: uPlot, the minimum and maximum of every pixel column (a one-sample spike still shows), the window ending at the clock's t, following live at 60 frames a second, click to seek, drag to zoom.

views.name: Level history
views.summary: One strip per stream, one bar per time bin, the worst level held in the bin (Grafana's Status history, RobotDx's health bar); a bin with no data is an empty outline, never a level.
